messages:
maya: Orchid Health reported a dedicated/on-prem isolation this morning 08:12 UTC. Symptoms look like the stale VPC peering + kernel reload race we saw earlier. Draft postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/orchid-isolation-draft. Need owners and a short remediation timeline.

liam: I can take peering hardening. Plan: 1) route validation on updates 2) enforce peer TTL 3) add a peer health probe + metric peer_stale_count. Target: canary in staging by Fri EOD.

sophia: I'll take the kernel/reload side. Repro requires Orchid staging access; @maya can you share? I already have a branch fix/iptables-reload-guard to open a PR after repro.

devin: I'll own alert tuning and the recurring audit. Proposed alert: isolate_incidents > 3 in 1h -> pager. I'll also create a weekly "isolation-sweep" invite for 6 weeks and update the runbook.

maya: Staging access granted, sec approved. Timeline suggestion: patch in staging Thu, canary Fri, rollout Mon. Weekly check-ins Wed 17:00Z x6.

infra-bot: Incident logged: INC-2026-1504. Severity: P2. First alert: 2026-03-21T08:12:34Z. Logs: /incidents/INC-2026-1504/logs.tar.gz

liam: ops tip: `ssh jump@orchid-staging -- sudo ip route show proto static | grep peer` to spot stale entries. I'll add a watchdog to auto-alert when peers look stale.

sophia: reproduced in staging per repro steps. race window confirmed during systemd-networkd reload. PR opened: #427, requesting net-eng review.

maya: Action items summary: 1) liam 0 peering hardening (ETA 2026-03-27) 2) sophia 0 reload-guard PR (ETA 2026-03-26) 3) devin 0 alert tuning + invite + runbook (ETA 2026-03-24) 4) maya 0 customer comms + finalize postmortem (ETA 2026-03-25). Please ack. :white_check_mark:

liam: ack :thumbsup:

devin: ack, creating tickets and invite now.

sophia: ack, PR flagged for review.

maya: Added tracker ORB-427 and linked canary playbook. If we hit blockers, post here and I'll escalate.

devin: Note: if >2 same-class isolations in 30d -> escalate to cross-team task force (eng-runtime + infra + platform). I'll add a tracker badge for that condition.

liam: Post-PR checklist: 1) 24h canary peering 2) peer_stale_count == 0 for 24h 3) no new isolate_incidents alerts.

sophia: running kernel config experiments in canary, will post results to tracker.

maya: thanks all, updating the draft and notifying Orchid support.
